prerequisites.title: SurveyMonkey account and Developer Account
prerequisites.detail: Anyone with a SurveyMonkey account can register an app; the developer registers a Developer Account first. Competitors of SurveyMonkey may not open one.

prerequisites.title: Paid plan for private app users
prerequisites.detail: Private app users must be on one team with a paid plan that offers API access.

prerequisites.title: Support and HTTPS
prerequisites.detail: Public apps need easily accessible support and HTTPS with a valid SSL certificate.

steps.title: Register a draft app
steps.detail: Register a draft app in your SurveyMonkey account and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Draft scope settings and redirect URI
steps.detail: Choose required, optional or not-required scopes. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it matches what you register.
steps.done_when: Scopes and redirect URI are set in app settings.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Deploy as private app
steps.detail: Deploy the draft as a private app before the 90-day window ends.

steps.title: Write the app listing
steps.detail: Draft an honest English listing stating whether users need a free or paid account from your service, and the scope requirements.

steps.title: Request approval for restricted scopes
steps.detail: Contact the SurveyMonkey help center with details of your app and use case.

steps.title: Deploy publicly and submit listing
steps.detail: Deploy as public, then create the listing in the My Apps listings tab and submit it for approval.

steps.title: Wait for SurveyMonkey approval
steps.detail: SurveyMonkey reviews the app; no timeline is documented.

traps.title: Limits are enforced only after the app exceeds them
traps.detail: Limits are enforced only after the app exceeds them three times within 30 days; three violations of up to 150% are permitted in a 30-day window.

traps.title: Limits are enforced at 100% once the app has
traps.detail: Limits are enforced at 100% once the app has exceeded them three times within 30 days.

traps.title: Draft apps are disabled after 90 days
traps.detail: A draft not deployed within 90 days is disabled. Other accounts cannot authenticate a draft app.

traps.title: Approval is discretionary
traps.detail: SurveyMonkey can reject an app on unlisted criteria, and approval does not guarantee compliance. It can also demote or remove a listed app.

traps.title: AI and competitor restrictions
traps.detail: The API terms prohibit using API content to build competing AI models or exporting content to competitors. Apps unrelated to surveys are not permitted.

traps.title: Private apps cannot serve many customers
traps.detail: Private apps are limited to one account or Team. Separate customers need a public app.

traps.title: Rate limits are low until raised
traps.detail: Draft and private apps start at 120 calls/minute and 500 calls/day. Public apps published in the directory get up to 500,000 per day; limits may change.

traps.title: Revoked tokens and rotated secrets
traps.detail: Users can revoke access tokens. Refreshing the app secret revokes all access to your app.

traps.title: Paid-plan scopes force upgrades
traps.detail: Customers without the right plan are asked to upgrade. Basic plans can read only 25 responses per survey.

blockers.symptom: Other accounts cannot authorize the app
blockers.what_it_means: The app is still a draft, and only the owner's account can authenticate it.
blockers.what_to_do: Deploy the app as public (with approval) or as private for one team.

blockers.symptom: Users are asked to upgrade during OAuth
blockers.what_it_means: A required scope is tied to a paid plan the user lacks.
blockers.what_to_do: Make plan-tied scopes optional, or tell customers which plan they need.
blockers.agent_can_help: Review scope settings and mark non-essential scopes optional.

open_questions: How long does public app review and listing approval take? Ask SurveyMonkey developer support; no timeline was found.
Is a directory listing required, or can an approved public app serve customers without one? Ask developer support.
